title: Pedestrian access leg continuous 1 m clear path

replaces.note: Part C C3.7.10-C3.7.12; new deemed exempt for R40 and below (Part B relied on subdivision policy)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Clear of utilities and minor projections, excluding eaves. Proposed fact.
text: Where a pedestrian access leg is required to provide access from a dwelling site to a public street, it is to: ii. provide a continuous path of travel with a minimum width of 1m, clear of any utilities or minor projections (excluding eaves).
